1.sahih_international: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
1.yusuf_ali: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
1.muhammad_sarwar: (On the day) when the sun is made to cease shining,
1.mohsin_khan: When the sun Kuwwirat (wound round and lost its light and is overthrown).
1.arberry: When the sun shall be darkened,

2.sahih_international: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
2.yusuf_ali: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
2.muhammad_sarwar: the stars are made to fade away,
2.mohsin_khan: And when the stars shall fall;
2.arberry: when the stars shall be thrown down,

3.sahih_international: And when the mountains are removed
3.pickthall: And when the hills are moved,
3.yusuf_ali: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
3.shakir: And when the mountains are made to pass away,
3.muhammad_sarwar: the mountains are scattered about as dust,
3.mohsin_khan: And when the mountains shall made to pass away;
3.arberry: when the mountains shall be set moving,

4.sahih_international: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
4.pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
4.yusuf_ali: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
4.shakir: And when the camels are left untended,
4.muhammad_sarwar: the young barren camels are abandoned,
4.mohsin_khan: And when the pregnant she-camels shall be neglected;
4.arberry: when the pregnant camels shall be neglected,

5.sahih_international: And when the wild beasts are gathered
5.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
5.yusuf_ali: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
5.shakir: And when the wild animals are made to go forth,
5.muhammad_sarwar: the wild beasts are herded together,
5.mohsin_khan: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together;
5.arberry: when the savage beasts shall be mustered,

6.sahih_international: And when the seas are filled with flame
6.yusuf_ali: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
6.shakir: And when the seas are set on fire,
6.muhammad_sarwar: the oceans are brought to a boil,
6.mohsin_khan: And when the seas shall become as blazing Fire or shall overflow;
6.arberry: when the seas shall be set boiling,

7.sahih_international: And when the souls are paired
7.yusuf_ali: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
7.muhammad_sarwar: souls are reunited with their bodies,
7.mohsin_khan: And when the souls shall be joined with their bodies;
7.arberry: when the souls shall be coupled,

8.sahih_international: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
8.pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
8.yusuf_ali: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
8.shakir: And when the female infant buried alive is asked
8.muhammad_sarwar: questions are asked about the baby girls buried alive,
8.mohsin_khan: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) shall be questioned.
8.arberry: when the buried infant shall be asked

9.sahih_international: For what sin she was killed
9.pickthall: For what sin she was slain,
9.yusuf_ali: For what crime she was killed;
9.shakir: For what sin she was killed,
9.muhammad_sarwar: such as, "For what crime were they murdered?"
9.mohsin_khan: For what sin she was killed?
9.arberry: for what sin she was slain,

10.sahih_international: And when the pages are made public
10.pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
10.yusuf_ali: When the scrolls are laid open;
10.shakir: And when the books are spread,
10.muhammad_sarwar: the records of deeds are made public,
10.mohsin_khan: And when the written pages of deeds (good and bad) of every person shall be laid open;
10.arberry: when the scrolls shall be unrolled,

11.sahih_international: And when the sky is stripped away
11.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
11.yusuf_ali: When the world on High is unveiled;
11.shakir: And when the heaven has its covering removed,
11.mohsin_khan: And when the heaven shall be stripped off and taken away from its place;
11.arberry: when heaven shall be stripped off;

12.sahih_international: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
12.yusuf_ali: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
12.shakir: And when the hell is kindled up,
12.mohsin_khan: And when Hell-fire shall be kindled to fierce ablaze.
12.arberry: when Hell shall be set blazing,

13.sahih_international: And when Paradise is brought near,
13.pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
13.yusuf_ali: And when the Garden is brought near;-
13.shakir: And when the garden is brought nigh,
13.mohsin_khan: And when Paradise shall be brought near,
13.arberry: when Paradise shall be brought nigh,

14.sahih_international: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
14.pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
14.yusuf_ali: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
14.shakir: Every soul shall (then) know what it has prepared.
14.muhammad_sarwar: then every soul will discover the consequence of its deeds.
14.mohsin_khan: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).
14.arberry: then shall a soul know what it has produced.

15.sahih_international: So I swear by the retreating stars -
15.pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
15.yusuf_ali: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
15.shakir: But nay! I swear by the stars,
15.muhammad_sarwar: I do not need to swear by the orbiting
15.mohsin_khan: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).
15.arberry: No! I swear by the slinkers,

16.sahih_international: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
16.pickthall: The stars which rise and set,
16.shakir: That run their course (and) hide themselves,
16.muhammad_sarwar: stars which are visible during the night
16.mohsin_khan: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves,

17.sahih_international: And by the night as it closes in
17.yusuf_ali: And the Night as it dissipates;
17.shakir: And the night when it departs,
17.muhammad_sarwar: and sit during the day, or by the darkening night
17.mohsin_khan: And by the night as it departs;

18.sahih_international: And by the dawn when it breathes
18.yusuf_ali: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
18.shakir: And the morning when it brightens,
18.mohsin_khan: And by the dawn as it brightens;

19.sahih_international: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
19.pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
19.yusuf_ali: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
19.shakir: Most surely it is the Word of an honored messenger,
19.muhammad_sarwar: that the Quran is the word of the honorable angelic, mighty Messenger
19.mohsin_khan: Verily, this is the Word (this Quran brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrael (Gabriel), from Allah to the Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him)].
19.arberry: truly this is the word of a noble Messenger

20.sahih_international: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
20.pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
20.yusuf_ali: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
20.shakir: The processor of strength, having an honorable place with the Lord of the Dominion,
20.muhammad_sarwar: who is honored in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
20.mohsin_khan: Owner of power, and high rank with (Allah) the Lord of the Throne,
20.arberry: having power, with the Lord of the Throne secure,

21.sahih_international: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
21.yusuf_ali: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
21.shakir: One (to be) obeyed, and faithful in trust.
21.muhammad_sarwar: obeyed by (all creatures) and faithful to His trust.
21.mohsin_khan: Obeyed (by the angels), trustworthy there (in the heavens).

22.sahih_international: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
22.pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.
22.yusuf_ali: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
22.shakir: And your companion is not gone mad.
22.muhammad_sarwar: Your companion (Muhammad) does not suffer from any mental illness
22.mohsin_khan: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) is not a madman;

23.sahih_international: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
23.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
23.yusuf_ali: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
23.shakir: And of a truth he saw himself on the clear horizon.
23.muhammad_sarwar: He certainly saw him (Gabriel) high up on the horizon in his original form
23.mohsin_khan: And indeed he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) saw him [Jibrael (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).
23.arberry: he truly saw him on the clear horizon;

24.sahih_international: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
24.pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
24.yusuf_ali: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
24.shakir: Nor of the unseen is he a tenacious concealer.
24.muhammad_sarwar: He (Muhammad) is not accused of lying about the unseen.
24.mohsin_khan: And he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) withholds not a knowledge of the unseen.
24.arberry: he is not niggardly of the Unseen.

25.sahih_international: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
25.pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
25.yusuf_ali: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
25.shakir: Nor is it the word of the cursed Shaitan,
25.muhammad_sarwar: The Quran is not the word of condemned satan.
25.mohsin_khan: And it (the Quran) is not the word of the outcast Shaitan (Satan).
25.arberry: And it is not the word of an accursed Satan;

27.sahih_international: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
27.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
27.yusuf_ali: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
27.shakir: It is naught but a reminder for the nations,
27.muhammad_sarwar: This is certainly the guidance for all (jinn and mankind).
27.mohsin_khan: Verily, this (the Quran) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns).
27.arberry: It is naught but a Reminder unto all beings,

28.sahih_international: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
28.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
28.yusuf_ali: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
28.shakir: For him among you who pleases to go straight.
28.muhammad_sarwar: So let those who want, choose the right guidance
28.mohsin_khan: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight,
28.arberry: for whosoever of you who would go straight;

29.sahih_international: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
29.pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
29.yusuf_ali: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
29.shakir: And you do not please except that Allah please, the Lord of the worlds.
29.muhammad_sarwar: However, you will not be able to choose anything unless God, Lord of the Universe wills it to be so.
29.mohsin_khan: And you will not, unless (it be) that Allah wills, the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
29.arberry: but will you shall not, unless God wills, the Lord of all Being.
